business_summary: Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited provides functional products and paper materials in Japan, Europe, Asia, North America, and internationally. It operates through Functional Materials, Sustainable Fiber Materials, and Engineering segments. The company offers graphic arts materials comprising CTP/CTF; functional products, including air filters, total heat exchange cores, battery separators, wet-laid nonwovens, fireproof glass fiber products, ThermoRewrite, and membrane support substrates; and water treatment membrane substrates, construction materials, separators for power storage devices, electronics materials, rewritable media, photosensitive and printing plate-making materials, information software products for printing applications, newspaper printing plates, information papers, heat-resistant pressboards, healthcare products, and paper straws. It also provides paper materials, including inkjet media and production inkjet papers; coated and uncoated graphic papers, magazine and specialty printing papers, hygienic and packing papers, electrical insulation press boards, white and specialty white paperboards, base papers for photographic papers, other specialty papers, and bleached kraft and specialty pulps; and chemical, printing, thermal, and sanitary papers. In addition, the company is involved in warehousing and transportation-related activities; operation of a biomass power generation business; engineering operations, including the design, manufacture, and maintenance of factory equipment; insurance agencies; and real estate activities. The company was formerly known as Mitsubishi Paper Mills Company and changed its name to Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited in November 1917. Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited was incorporated in 1898 and is headquartered in Sumida, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited는 일본, 유럽, 아시아, 북미 및 국제적으로 기능성 제품과 종이 재료를 제공합니다. 기능성 재료, 지속 가능한 섬유 재료 및 엔지니어링 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 CTP/CTF로 구성된 그래픽 아트 자료를 제공합니다. 공기 필터, 전열 교환 코어, 배터리 분리막, 습식 부직포, 내화 유리 섬유 제품, ThermoRewrite 및 멤브레인 지지 기판을 포함한 기능성 제품; 수처리용 막 기판, 건축자재, 전력저장장치용 분리판, 전자재료, 재기록매체, 감광성 및 인쇄 제판 재료, 인쇄용 정보 소프트웨어 제품, 신문 인쇄판, 정보지, 내열성 합판, 헬스케어 제품, 종이 빨대 등이 있습니다. 또한 잉크젯 미디어 및 생산 잉크젯 용지를 포함한 종이 재료도 제공합니다. 코팅 및 비코팅 그래픽 용지, 잡지 및 특수 인쇄지, 위생용 및 포장지, 전기 절연 프레스 보드, 흰색 및 특수 흰색 판지, 사진 용지용 원지, 기타 특수 용지 및 표백 kr
